setup.cardDescription: Sync your data securely across all your devices.
setup.foundOtherDevices: Other connected devices were found on your account. Continue to connect this device.
setup.encryptedInfo: Your data is end-to-end encrypted. Only your devices can read it.

stale.keysNeedUpdatingDescription: Security settings changed on another device. Connect this device again to keep syncing.

orphaned.restoreTitle: Use This Device to Restore Sync
orphaned.restoreDescription: No other connected device is available. We'll restart sync using the data already on this device.
orphaned.confirmDescription: We'll restart sync using the data already on this device.

untrusted.notConnectedYet: This device is not connected yet

untrusted.enterCodeGeneric: Enter the code from your other connected device to sync your data.
untrusted.connectToStartSyncing: Connect this device to start syncing.

waitingSnapshot.otherDeviceFinishing: Your other device is still finishing setup.
waitingSnapshot.trustedHint: You can speed things up now, or wait and we'll continue automatically in the background.
waitingSnapshot.untrustedHint: Please finish setup on your other connected device first. This page will update automatically.

snapshot.uploadedDescription: Newly connected devices can now finish syncing from this snapshot.

reinit.title: Set up sync again from this device?
reinit.description: We'll keep the data on this device and use it to restart sync. Other connected devices may need to be connected again.

recovery.title: Set up this device again
recovery.description: Sync was turned off for this device. Set it up again to keep your data up to date across your devices.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect this device?
disconnectDialog.description: This will remove sync from this device. You can set it up again later.

unpairDialog.descriptionLast: This is your only connected device. You'll need to connect a device again to continue syncing your data.
unpairDialog.description: This will remove "{{name}}" from your account. The device will need to be connected again to sync data.

pairing.enterCodeDescription: Enter the code shown on your other device.
pairing.scanOrEnterDescription: Scan this code with your new device, or type it in there.
pairing.gettingReadyDescription: This will only take a moment.
pairing.prepareFailed: We couldn't finish getting this device ready.
pairing.transferringDataDescription: Encrypting a copy of your data for your new device. This can take a minute.
pairing.securingConnectionDescription: Exchanging encryption keys with your other device.

displayCode.expiredDescription: Codes work for a few minutes to keep pairing secure. Get a new one to continue.

enterCode.scanInstructions: Align the QR code inside the frame.
enterCode.cameraOpenError: Unable to open camera. Please try again.
enterCode.cameraCloseError: Unable to close camera. Please try again.
enterCode.cameraUnavailable: No camera is available. Use a physical device to scan, or enter the pairing code below.
enterCode.scanHint: Point your camera at the code on your other device.

sas.description: Make sure your other device shows the same code. This keeps anyone else from connecting.

sas.mismatchDescription: The codes didn't match, so nothing was shared. Try again with a new code.

waiting.waitingForConfirmation: Waiting for your other device to confirm…

transferring.description: Downloading and checking the encrypted copy from your other device.

waiting.title: Waiting for your other device
waiting.description: Your other device is still uploading its data. Setup continues automatically.

consent.title: Replace the data in this profile?
consent.description: Data from your other device will replace the data on this device.
consent.descriptionDated: Data from your other device (copied {{date}}) will replace the data on this device.

backingUp.title: Backing up this profile
backingUp.description: Saving a copy of this profile before anything is replaced.

replacing.title: Replacing data on this device
replacing.description: Putting the data from your other device in place.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: This device is set up and in sync.

cancelled.title: Setup was cancelled
cancelled.description: Nothing was replaced. You can finish setup at any time.

retryHint.consent: Nothing was replaced. Trying again asks for your approval again.
retryHint.new_attempt: Nothing was replaced. Start again to use the latest copy from your other device.

errors.SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The transferred data couldn't be verified
